{{Vanilla|Short Grass}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Short grass''' is the most common ground plant in the Overworld. Matcha Flavoured makes [[Wheat Grain|wheat grain]] (vanilla wheat seeds) drop from grass only when it is cut with a hoe, lets hoes collect grass and other plants the way shears do, and adds recipes that dry and combine grasses. This page also covers ferns, tall grass and the dry grasses, which follow the same rules.

! Plant !! Hand or other tool !! Hoe !! Shears

|-

|-

<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/short_grass.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/tall_grass.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/fern.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/vine.json}}</ref>
In vanilla, any tool or a bare hand gives the 12.5% seed chance from grass and ferns. In the pack only a hoe does, and ferns never drop seeds. Items and blocks that do not count as a hoe, including the [[Mattock|mattock]], use the "other tool" column. Bushes and dry grasses can also be collected with {{MCW|Silk Touch}}.

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
* Two short grass make a tall grass, and two ferns a large fern.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/tall_grass.json}}</ref>
* Cooking short grass or a fern in an [[oven]] (5 seconds) or on [[Kindling|kindling]] (10 seconds) gives short dry grass, and tall grass or a large fern gives tall dry grass. A bush cooks into a dead bush.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/oven/short_dry_grass.json}}</ref>
* Two short dry grass make a tall dry grass, and a tall dry grass splits back into 2 short. [[Straw]] crafts into 2 tall dry grass.
* Short grass, a fern or a bush between two sticks makes [[Tinder|tinder]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/tinder.json}}</ref>
